priceNote: Confirmed unchanged by the owner on 2026-09-22 (previously 2026-08-22). Values were set 2026-06-11 (PR #342) and have not been changed since — the owner states the prices are still current. **Still not machine-verified against App Store Connect**: IAP prices are not returned by the iTunes Lookup API, and the ASC API needs credentials this sandbox does not have. Prices appear on the site (pricing sections and JSON-LD offers), so a stale value would be a consumer-protection risk, not just a docs bug: Apple periodically adjusts JPY price tiers for FX. If that ever happens, update these four fields and this note's date, then run node scripts/sync_constants.js --write. Checked by scripts/check-store-facts.mjs (180-day window; longer than ratings because prices rarely change, but not unbounded).
